description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the WorkShiftEmployeeAPI class within the OrangeHRM Admin API module. It contains test methods for the API endpoints, proper setup, and data providers to validate API behavior, mainly focusing on the 'getAll' operation and notImplemented exceptions for create and delete operations.

classes.name: WorkShiftEmployeeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the WorkShiftEmployeeAPI, testing API methods and validation within the OrangeHRM admin module.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the WorkShiftEmployeeAPI, using data providers and mock services.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the 'getAll' endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'create' on the API throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures that validation rules for create are not implemented and throw an exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Checks that 'delete' operation throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for delete are not implemented.
